lines.en: Slither forward

lines.zh: 我这一块，比母体小一半。
lines.en: This piece of me is half the parent's size.

lines.zh: 我一下一下地弹，挪向你脚边。
lines.en: I bounce little by little toward your feet.
Hisss and move
Crawl low to ground
Creep quietly

lines.zh: 碎成小块，我还是一样弹。
lines.en: Broken small, I still bounce the same.
Crawl near ground
Creep forward

lines.zh: 小肉块一蹦一跳地挪动
lines.en: The little cube hops and shuffles along.

lines.zh: 分裂后的小身子弹跳前行
lines.en: Split from its parent, it bounces forward.

lines.zh: 肉块贴着地面缓缓滑动
lines.en: The flesh rubs slowly over the ground.
Wait quietly
Silent patrol

lines.zh: 我等下一具尸体掉下来。
lines.en: I wait for the next corpse to fall.

lines.zh: 我伏在地上，像块普通的肉。
lines.en: I lie on the ground like an ordinary piece of meat.
Wander slowly

lines.zh: 肉块贴着地面，等谁走近。
lines.en: The flesh clings to the floor, waiting for someone.

lines.zh: 我在血泊里慢慢鼓起来。
lines.en: I swell slowly in the pool of blood.
Swim slowly
Hide quietly
Patience lurks
The tiny cube swells and shrinks in place.
It balls up to pass for rotten meat.
It pulses, waiting to split again.
It lies still out on the flesh plains.

lines.zh: 从大块身上裂下来，还会跳。
lines.en: Split off the big one, and I still bounce.

lines.zh: 我从大块上掉下来，还剩一点力气。
lines.en: I fell off the big one and still have some strength.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的那一刻，我醒了。
lines.en: The moment you stepped on me, I woke.

lines.zh: 我表面的纹路朝你这边聚拢。
lines.en: The patterns on me gather toward you.
Broken into bits, still looking for you.

lines.zh: 我从血泥里抬起一角对着你。
lines.en: I lift one corner from the bloody mud toward you.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转向你，表面冒出汗珠。
lines.en: I turn toward you, beads forming on my surface.
There's a bit of me left — enough to hop

lines.zh: 我身上裂开的口子，都在闻你。
lines.en: Every split on my body sniffs for you.
One small hop, and its gaze locks on you.
The split in its flesh turns toward you.

lines.zh: 用新长出的眼睛打量你
lines.en: It sizes you up with a newly grown eye.

lines.zh: 小肉块判断着你的距离
lines.en: The tiny cube measures the gap to you.
It fixes on your ankle and stays there.
It swells and leans your way.
It has memorized your smell.

lines.zh: 小肉块瞄准了你的影子
lines.en: It takes aim at your shadow.
Even a split-off knows living flesh.

lines.zh: 它估算着扑上来的距离
lines.en: It works out how far it must leap.

lines.zh: 肉块表面短暂睁开了眼
lines.en: An eye briefly opens on its surface.
Muscle torn, it hurts!
Body fractured, pain!

lines.zh: 我被削掉一块，地上黏糊糊的。
lines.en: A piece of me is cut away, sticky on the floor.
Wound hurts, annoying!
Muscle damaged, hurts!
Muscle ruptured, painful!
Severely injured, dying!
Tendons snapped, in pain!
Injured, stay away!
Muscle torn, unlucky!

lines.zh: 你散发的味道让我垂涎
lines.en: You smell tempting.

lines.zh: 靠近我，你会死得很痛苦
lines.en: Come closer, and you’ll suffer.
Your blood, my meal.
Don’t stop, I’m not full yet.
This is my territory, back off.

lines.zh: 我会享受撕裂你的过程
lines.en: I’ll enjoy tearing you apart.
Your flesh is delicious.
I won’t easily give up my prey.
Split into pieces, I still hunger for you.

lines.zh: 我的存在就是对你的威胁
lines.en: My existence is a threat to you.
Beware, my tentacles are deadly.
Collision means death.
You’ve touched my territory.
Avoid me, or you’ll get hurt.

lines.zh: 我的弹跳会要了你的命
lines.en: My jump will kill you.
Don’t get close, you’ll regret it.

lines.zh: 我的触角可以穿透你的皮肤
lines.en: My tentacles can pierce your skin.
I’ll grab you and cause you pain.
Your body isn’t tough enough.

lines.zh: 我会用我的力量碾碎你
lines.en: I’ll crush you with my strength.

lines.zh: 找到我的同类，互相繁衍
lines.en: Find my mate to reproduce.

lines.zh: 我的同类在那边，靠近它们
lines.en: My mates are over there, get close.

lines.zh: 我需要伴侣来繁衍后代
lines.en: I need a mate to reproduce.

lines.zh: 寻找我的配偶，合作生存
lines.en: Find my mate, we can survive together.
My mates will protect us.

lines.zh: 靠近我的同类，我们共存
lines.en: Get close to my mate, we can coexist.
My mates provide safety.

lines.zh: 我的同类在附近，靠近它们
lines.en: My mates are nearby, get close.
Establish a connection with my mate.

lines.zh: 我的同类可以带来食物
lines.en: My mates can bring food.

lines.zh: 吱吱响，肉块黏稠，好恶心！
lines.en: Squeak, slimy bits, gross!

lines.zh: 这黏糊糊的东西，拿起来真不舒服！
lines.en: This sticky stuff, awkward to hold.
Tastes like rotten flesh, yuck!
The smell of small flesh, unpleasant.

lines.zh: 这玩意儿应该直接扔掉！
lines.en: Just toss this thing away.
Slippery, can't hold.
Looks like torn flesh.

lines.zh: 这东西摸起来黏糊糊的！
lines.en: Feels sticky!
How gross this small flesh is!
Drop it, don't touch!

lines.zh: 猎物就在附近，准备好攻击！
lines.en: Prey nearby, ready to attack!

lines.zh: 目标锁定，准备跳跃攻击！
lines.en: Target acquired, ready to jump!
Tasty prey!

lines.zh: 目标就在脚下，准备吞噬！
lines.en: Target at feet, ready to devour!
Prey scent detected.

lines.zh: 猎物近了，准备一击必杀！
lines.en: Prey approaching, one hit kill!
Prey's scent, ready to bite!

lines.zh: 猎物就在眼前，准备吞噬！
lines.en: Prey in sight, ready to devour!

lines.zh: 捕食目标锁定，准备攻击！
lines.en: Prey locked, ready to attack!

lines.zh: 目标就在眼前，准备吞噬！
lines.en: Target in sight, ready to devour!
It smells you and snaps into a crouch.
Locked on your feet, it readies a jump.
The little cube has decided you are prey.
It gathers itself toward you.
A split-off can still find the living.
Blood in the air, and it coils to spring.

lines.zh: 锁定目标，准备跳起攻击！
lines.en: Locking target, ready to jump!
Locking prey, ready to bite!
Prey in sight, ready to attack!

lines.zh: 目标就在眼前，准备吞噬
lines.en: Target in sight, ready to devour!

lines.zh: 碎成小块的我，弹起来更快。
lines.en: Split into a small piece, I bounce faster.

lines.zh: 猎物就在脚下，准备吞食！
lines.en: Prey at feet, ready to devour!

lines.zh: 我一缩一弹，朝你的脚边跳。
lines.en: I compress and spring toward your feet.

lines.zh: 从大块身上裂下来的小肉块。
lines.en: A small chunk split off the big one.
Locking prey, ready to devour!
It tightens up, ready to hop over.
Bounce by bounce, the gap closes.
The cube flattens and springs at you.

lines.zh: 它算好了落点在你身上
lines.en: It has picked where to land on you.
Closer with every bounce, never resting.
A hiss squeezes out of the small body.
It aims its leap at your knee.
The flesh trembles as it charges up.
It is about to throw itself at you.
It has chosen the shadow at your feet.
The silence before the leap is worst.

lines.zh: 你感受到我的存在了吗？
lines.en: Feel my presence.
My touch will grab you!

lines.zh: 我裂出来的小块，也会弹着咬你。
lines.en: This little chunk split from the mass still bounces and bites.
Move, or you'll be torn!
My flesh will consume you!
My flesh will stick to you!

lines.zh: 大块裂开，我就是那一小块。
lines.en: The big one split — I'm the little piece.

lines.zh: 大块裂开，我是碎的那块。
lines.en: The big one split; I am the shard.
You will be devoured!
My tentacles will pierce you!
The small cube slams into your shin.
It springs up and bites your foot.
A wet, sticky thud.
It hits you and bounces away.
The small body knocks you back a step.
The flesh rolls over your instep.

lines.zh: 母体裂开，我从缝里弹出来。
lines.en: The parent split, and I bounced out.

lines.zh: 我从地下爬出，寻找猎物！
lines.en: I crawl from the ground, seeking prey!
I emerge from the rot!
The flesh splits, here I come!
I crawl from the corpse!
I emerge from the decaying flesh!
The flesh splits, here I come!

lines.zh: 我从地底爬出，寻找猎物！
lines.en: I crawl from the ground, seeking prey!
I emerge from death!
The big cube bursts and I drop free.
I roll out of my parent's remains.

lines.zh: 碎裂的血肉堆里钻出我
lines.en: I crawl out of the broken flesh pile.
The parent died, but I remain.
One more lump on the flesh plains.
I am still twitching as I land.
I well up out of the rotting scraps.
The split is done; I open my eyes.

lines.zh: 我带着母体的碎渣落地
lines.en: I land with bits of my parent on me.
The cube splits open and I hop out.
This patch of rot is mine now.
Burned by fire!
Fallen, hurts!
Drowning, suffocating!
Explosion, run!

lines.zh: 分裂出来的小块，也会疼。
lines.en: Even a split-off cube can hurt.

lines.zh: 那股光照得我直缩，皮都皱了。
lines.en: That light makes me shrink, my skin puckering.
Starvation, find food!
Lightning, hurts!
Void, despair!
